---
title: "`r params$tab_name`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    number_sections: true
    latex_engine: xelatex
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{fontspec}
  - \setmainfont{Arial}
params:
  tab_name: "Title"
  results_table: NULL
  n_subtypes: 2
  pdf_level_col_width: "10em"
  pdf_count_col_width: "8em"
  pdf_pval_col_width: "5em"
  pdf_test_col_width: "5em"
  pdf_tab_font_size: 8
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Generate the kable with custom column width for specific columns
kbl <- kable(params$results_table, align = c('l', 'c', rep('c', params$n_subtypes), 'c', 'c'), 
             caption = params$tab_name) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c('striped', 'scale_down', 'repeat_header', 'hold_position'), 
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = params$pdf_tab_font_size) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = params$pdf_level_col_width) %>%
  column_spec(2, width = params$pdf_level_col_width)

# Dynamically add column_spec for subtype columns
for (i in 1:params$n_subtypes) {
  kbl <- kbl %>% column_spec(2 + i, width = params$pdf_count_col_width)
}

# Add column_spec for p-value and test columns
kbl <- kbl %>%
  column_spec(2 + params$n_subtypes + 1, width = params$pdf_pval_col_width) %>%
  column_spec(2 + params$n_subtypes + 2, width = params$pdf_test_col_width)

# Print the final table
kbl
